families.source_note: Numeric dimensions supplied by the project owner and transcribed for reuse. This source label records the owner's input; the open-source project has not independently measured physical samples.

display_assumptions.description: Conditional central floor thickness used for display modelling; not a measured material thickness.
Nominal per-side lid clearance used for display modelling; not a physical fit, sealing or retention-force result.
Height minus cavity depth is 2 mm, the inner-floor height relative to the support plane. It is not the outer-bottom recess or the material thickness.
Corner radii, locking-channel section, skirt engagement, ribs and mark depths were visual assumptions. Those details and commercial meshes are not included in this numeric catalog.
